minor.issue: Does not accept school_id query param for super_admin; only reads X-School-Id header. Passing ?school_id=<KNP> returns 0 exams silently (falls back to default school). Frontend school switcher uses X-School-Id so UI works; but API is inconsistent with other endpoints (students, payments, fees) that DO accept school_id query.

integration_issues.issue: For multi-child parent 6376066570, both children (Gaurav KNP-972, Shivam KNP-973) show 'No results published yet' because seeded Half-Yearly is scoped to a specific class_id/section that does not include these two students. Not a bug per se, but seed_exams.py picks 'first class with students' which happens to exclude this test parent's children -- consider seeding a report card for at least one of the documented test parents so /parent/results has content to demo.
